en: Color postcard view of a compact alpine town in a narrow green valley surrounded by steep, forested mountains. In the distance, pale rocky peaks rise above the tree line, resembling the Dolomites. The town features dense clusters of pastel-colored houses with red-tiled roofs and a prominent church with a tall, dark spire at the center. Trees and foliage frame the scene in the foreground, and the image has the slightly tinted, printed look of mid‑20th‑century postcards. No visible text appears on the image side.
